name: System UIcons
about: System UIcons is a free, open-source icon set with 432 icons designed by Corey Ginnivan. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Unlicense.

faqs.q: Are System UIcons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 432 System UIcons are open source under the Unlicense license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Unlicense terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use System UIcons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many System UIcons are there?
faqs.a: There are 432 icons in the System UIcons set, designed by Corey Ginnivan. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of System UIcons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are System UIcons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
